I changed `OrderPlaced` to publish the old field names as well as the new ones, which should clear the two ARCH-4 failures. I couldn't run the ARCH-4 contract check, because it isn't in this repo. Locally, the tests (39), typecheck and `npm run arch` all pass.

The event now carries `createdAt` and `amountCents`, plus `placedAt` and `totalCents` with the same values. The old two are marked `@deprecated` in `src/core/events.ts`, and `test/app.test.ts` expects all four.

`analytics-ingest` and `billing-service` still require `placedAt` and `totalCents`, so a straight rename breaks them. Publishing both names lets the Payments and Customer API naming exist now without breaking those two.

Once both consumers have moved to the new names, remove the two deprecated fields. That is also a good point to bump `schemaVersion`.
